row.evidence: Murex's security page says MX.3 'supports multifactor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO) and security assertion markup language (SAML) authorization', but no Murex page mentions SCIM or user provisioning and product docs are behind the customer portal.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: Murex publishes no pricing; MX.3 (capital markets trading, risk and post-trade platform) is sold by contract for on-premises, cloud or MXSaaS deployment. SAML SSO is supported (plan not stated). No SCIM, provisioning or user API is documented publicly; docs are in the customer portal. Okta has no Murex app; Entra has no tutorial. Status unknown rather than none because admin docs are not public.

plans.name: MX.3 (quote-only; on-premises, cloud or MXSaaS)
plans.notes: Murex lists no plans or prices; MX.3 is sold by contract and deployed at the customer site, on the cloud, or as vendor-managed MXSaaS.

scim.notes: No SCIM or user-provisioning documentation on murex.com; MX.3 product documentation sits behind the customer portal.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'murex' returns no results.

entra.notes: No Murex entry in the Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).

fallbacks.notes: Murex says MX.3 supports SSO and SAML 'to allow for interoperability with centralized access management systems' and has built-in identity management with role-based access control; it does not say whether accounts are provisioned from the IdP (JIT or SCIM).
